benchmark.name: HebrewBankBench v1
benchmark.scoring: gold answer at rank 1 over the full 131,072-token vocabulary

optimization.collateral_statement: zero collateral above a float32-verified floor of 565/573 controls; 8 of the original 573 were found, under corrected batched-regime ranking with two measurement bugs fixed, to have never actually reached rank 1 -- an original-scan misclassification, not repair-caused damage. Verified against the corrected 565-control set.
optimization.measurement_note: ranks_batched carried two bugs, both fixed and independently verified before this measurement: (1) a row finishing scaffold-walk early was reading a later, padded-and-masked position's logits instead of its own; (2) no explicit padding-aware position_ids for left-padded batches. A residual bf16 exact-tie effect on borderline questions was also found and is why this certificate's numbers are measured in float32 (see verification.precision).

repair.v1_gate: scalar threshold: relu(x.khat - thr) -- baked into served weights (silu-unit MLP widening, exact within 2.7e-4 of true relu)
repair.v2_gate: 56-dim centered-cosine fingerprint gate, threshold 0.95 -- served as a runtime plugin layer (this gate has no scalar-projection form, so it cannot be baked with the v1 technique)

monitoring.statement: monitoring active on every layer for every generated token

guardian.statement: Guardian rules are an injection and jailbreak pre-filter, run before the GPU. They are not a financial-advice or clinical-hallucination filter.

verification.precision: float32 head (bf16 backbone, fp32 final hidden state + norm + lm_head) -- bf16 was found to produce exact logit ties on borderline questions that flip rank by batch composition; float32 resolves them. bf16 remains standard for scan, repair, and production serving.

disclosures: Accuracy is measured as the gold answer reaching rank 1 over the full vocabulary.

Collateral is reported above a float32-verified floor; 8 of the original 573 controls were reclassified from 'correct' to 'fixable' after the corrected measurement showed they never reached rank 1 -- not repair-caused damage.

v2's 799 vectors are served as a runtime plugin, not baked into the weights, because their gate (a 56-dim fingerprint cosine) has no representation as the scalar-projection silu-widening technique used to bake v1.
Guardian rules are an injection and jailbreak pre-filter. They are not financial or medical advice filters.
The method is patent-protected and is not described in this certificate.
